## Summary

Explain the user problem and the solution in a few sentences.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Source adapter
- [ ] AI or retrieval change
- [ ] Relationship intelligence change
- [ ] Dashboard or accessibility change
- [ ] Documentation or maintenance

## Evidence and safety

- [ ] Outputs remain attributable to stored evidence.
- [ ] I reviewed security, privacy, source-policy, and abuse implications.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, cookies, personal information, private target data, generated output, or local URLs.
- [ ] Collection changes are bounded and do not bypass authentication, CAPTCHAs, paywalls, or technical access controls.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests pass with `python -m pytest -q`.
- [ ] Dashboard lint passes with `npm run lint`.
- [ ] Dashboard production build passes with `npm run build`.
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` are updated where needed.
- [ ] New database changes use an additive numbered migration.

## Screenshots or sample output

Add sanitized screenshots or output when the change affects the interface.
